ordinary_coach_decision.words: Board your paid coach and physically reach Pittsburgh.
ordinary_coach_decision.intention: To reach the terminal with Alma's addressed claim slip.
ordinary_coach_decision.detail: The slip is sealed and will be filed next morning.

source_context.producer_following_effect: Rita covers the party with her notebook.

decision.words: Take two minutes to collect Alma’s addressed envelope. Board this same coach in the second group.
decision.intention: Collect the envelope to continue the journey.
decision.detail: The envelope is sealed with Alma’s claim, so my intention is to board the coach and use it for the return post.

decision.words: Walk past the post window, keep the envelope unfiled and take your current place at the payphone.
decision.intention: I plan to call my sister about her Wednesday move.
decision.detail: I cannot see what it says.

events: Phil collects the addressed envelope and boards in the second group.
Phil takes his payphone place with the unfiled envelope. There will be no signed delivery tomorrow.
